page.layout: One printed page of dictionary text, one column, entries in Latin with Hebrew headwords and Hebrew quotations. Page numbers in Hebrew letters at the head, left and right. Catchword at the right foot. No margin notes.

main_text.p: Spolii permulti, Jesa.33.23. Construct. למרבה השלל Amplitudini principatus, Jesa.9. v.7. scribitur cum Mem clauso sive finali in medio, sed juxta Masorethas legendum cum Mem aperto, למרבה [?]. De Mem clauso videtur Petrus Galatinus lib.4. cap.19. Locus tamen, quem ibi ex Talmudicis adducit, quod Mem clausum denotet rem clausam, falsus est. Nihil enim tale quid toto isto capite in Talmud dicitur.
מרבה f. Amplus, Ampla: מרבה להכיל Amplum est ad capiendum, Ezech.23.32. id est, Capacissimum.

מרבית f. Multitudo, Pars multa vel magna, 1.Par.12. v.29. Foenus, quasi Augmentum, Auctarium fortiu principalis, Levit.25.37. Soboles, 1.Sam.2, v.33. Amplitudo, 2.Paralip.9.6. Aff. מרביתם Magna pars, multi illorum, 1.Par.12.29.
תרבות f. Turba, Multitudo: תיבות אנשים הטאוים Turba hominum peccatorum: vel, Soboles, Progenies, Indoles, Num.32.14. quasi Educationem dicas.
רבך f. Bullatum, Frixum, frigendo vel coquendo bullatum factum, Levit.6. v.21. al.14. Est Part.Hophal. Sic Chaldaicè רביכא Frixum.

רבע Quadratum esse vel fieri: Item, Coire, Inire: & de coitu quadrupedum tantum dicitur. Particip. Pahul, רבוע Quadratum, Exod.27.1. Plural. רבעים Quadrata, 1.Reg.7.5. Foemin. מרבעה Positis quadratus, Ezech.41.21. Infinit. ex altera significatione, לרבעה Ut ineat eam, Levit.18.23. & 20.16. Pyh. Partic, מרבע Quadratum, Ezech.4.5.2. Foemin. מרבעת Ezech.40.47. Plural. מרבעו Quadrata, 1.Reg.7.41. Hiph. Futurum, לא תרביע Ne facito vel finito coire, Levit.19.19.

page.notes: Page numbers in Hebrew letters: the right-hand one is doubtful. Hebrew words were copied as far as legible; the vowel points and some letters in the small Hebrew phrases (e.g. למרבה, מרבה, מרבית, תרבות, תרבית) are not certain and may differ slightly from the printed forms. The Hebrew of the headword "רבך" and of the Chaldaic form רביכא is doubtful. Long s is written as s; "Jefa" is read as Jesa. The Google watermark at the lower right is not transcribed.
